tests.title: Document() is always Prefix followed by Task byte for byte

tests.title: An unknown brain name is a usage failure listing the registered names

tests.title: --script without scripted, and scripted without --script, are usage errors naming --script

tests.title: Box environment equals exactly the host values of BoxEnv names

tests.title: With host tokens set, the agentkit and scripted boxes carry an empty environment

tests.title: Open on a work tree's top level creates the spec, syncs with .git and records ledger entries in order

tests.title: A HostDir that is not a work tree or not its top level is refused with a usage failure

tests.title: A provider that cannot create a sandbox yields failed/sandbox, not retryable

tests.title: A sync failure closes the sandbox and yields failed/sandbox retryable

tests.title: Session.Sync re-syncs the host directory and records another box_sync

tests.title: The box HEAD equals the host HEAD and a commit inside leaves the host untouched

the commit is not on the host's branch

tests.title: For any synced repository state the box's short HEAD equals the host's

tests.title: For any file write or commit inside the box the host checkout is unchanged

tests.title: FS(ctx) is read-only, maps a missing path to fs.ErrNotExist and stats a directory as a directory

tests.title: WriteFile refuses invalid paths and paths outside .agent-fox/ with an internal error and writes nothing

tests.title: Export writes the brain's edits to an af-export directory under the temp dir without .git
